$comment: Speedy Skirmisher (OS Kai model). Numbers start from Kai's Barrage / Blazing Pace / Giga Blast. Was Pikachu's kit until 2026-11 (Discharge = Thunder Shock, Wild Charge = Volt Tackle). Pass 5 (2026-11-07, data-mined GA_Blast = Kai's Barrage: 5 fireballs 0.125 s apart, 1725/s, radius 25, LIGHT, 700+32.5 % core, 60+25 % KB and dmg): Discharge now 5 bolts 0.125 s apart after a 0.15 s wind-up, range 900, hovering 0.25 s at the end (linger), player knockback +30 % (146+61 %), ball 750+35 %.

moves.name: Discharge
moves.desc: After a short wind-up, fire 5 LIGHT bolts one after another. They hover for a moment at the end of their range, batting away the ball and enemies that touch them.

moves.name: Agility
moves.desc: +30% speed for 5 s. Castable while firing.

moves.name: Wild Charge
moves.desc: Charge forward, blasting enemies and the ball out of your way.
